name: You Ain't Done Yet
subtitle: The Comeback Sequence

audience.description: Applicants needing a second shot, especially gig workers and microbusiness owners

voice: Marine grit, respect, humor and curiosity. Human not corporate. Never imply approval or shame financial hardship.

steps.subject: You pulled the trigger. Respect. 🫡
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Got word you put in a funding application.

First off, hell yeah. Respect. 🫡

I don't know your story yet. Maybe business is booming and you're chasing your next move. Maybe things are tight and you need breathing room.

Either way, you did something about it. That counts.

The funding provider handles the application decision. Me? I'm interested in something else.

What are you actually fighting for?

A better life? A business? Getting out of survival mode? More freedom?

I've been broke and knocked on my ass. Where you are today doesn't have to be where you end up.

Hit reply. Tell me what you're trying to change. One sentence. No bullshit. No perfect answer.

Semper Fi,
Jason
Moonshine Capital

steps.subject: Quick question. What's your Plan B?
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

What if the funding doesn't come through?

Not trying to be a buzzkill. Hope matters. A plan matters more.

If you had to find another $500–$1,000 over the next month without borrowing, where would you start? More customers? Another gig? Something you already know how to do?

I found one thing that might help: {{resource_title}} — {{resource_url}}

What's the biggest thing standing between you and your next move?

Jason

steps.subject: You don't have to figure it all out alone.
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

One thing the Marines taught me: tough people still need a good team.

Money matters. So do skills, people and opportunity.

If you're building something, come check out our Capital Launchpad Network: https://www.distilledfunding.com/group/capital-launchpad-network/

Lurk, connect, or tell us what you're working on. And if you want to talk, hit reply.

Semper Fi,
Jason

reply_branches.question: Is this a temporary setback, or has it been a struggle for a while?
reply_branches.response:
I hear you, {{first_name}}. When bills stack up it's hard to think about anything else.

But one question: will borrowing fix the problem, or just push it out a few weeks?

Is this a temporary setback or something that's been going on for a while?

Let's start there.

Jason

reply_branches.question: Repair or replacement?
reply_branches.response:
Damn, {{first_name}}. The thing that earns your money is keeping you from earning it.

Are we talking about one repair that'll get you moving, or a car that's turned into a money pit? What would it actually take to get back on the road?

Jason

reply_branches.question: What would you sell, and to whom?
reply_branches.response:
Now you've got my attention, {{first_name}}.

An idea is one thing. A business somebody pays for is another.

What would you sell, who would buy it, and why would they pick you? No 40-page plan needed. Just tell me what you've got cooking.

Jason

reply_branches.question: What would you do with the money first?
reply_branches.response:
Okay, {{first_name}}, now we're talking.

If the money landed tomorrow, what would you do with it first? And how would that turn into more revenue, margin, or time back in your week?

Tell me the real plan.

Jason

reply_branches.question: What's one change you want in six months?
reply_branches.response:
I respect that, {{first_name}}.

Sometimes all you know is you want something better. That's a start.

Six months from now, what's ONE thing you wish were different? Work, income, freedom, family?

Pick one. I'm curious.

Jason

reply_branches.question: No follow-up question
reply_branches.response:
Fair point, {{first_name}}. You applied for funding, not a motivational boot camp. 😂

The provider handles the application decision. If you'd rather leave it there, understood. No more relationship emails from this sequence.

If you ever want to talk strategy, you know where to find me.

Jason

outcome_branches.subject: Well, that wasn't the answer we wanted.
outcome_branches.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Saw the application update. Not the answer we hoped for. That sucks.

One provider saying no isn't the end of your story.

What were you planning to do with that money that matters most right now? There may be a different path—or a better next move before borrowing again.

Jason

outcome_branches.subject: You got funded. Now what?
outcome_branches.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Heard the good news. You got funded. Hell yeah. 🫡

Take the win.

Now tell me: what's your first move? What would make you look back six months from now and say, 'Damn, that was worth it'?

Semper Fi,
Jason
